# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 9 tokens; Text — 4 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 1 token; Borders and rings — 2 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 14 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 11 tokens; Radius — 5 tokens; Shadow — 3 tokens; Layout — 21 tokens; Icon — 4 tokens; Z index — 7 tokens; Timing — 7 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--surface-canvas, #f7f8fa);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--surface-canvas, #181b20);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #f7f8fa;
```

### Tokens (9)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface-canvas` | #f7f8fa | #181b20 | 工作区主背景；正文 primary/secondary/muted 均可读。 |
| `--surface-nav` | #eef0f3 | #14171c | 全局 Rail 与会话侧栏；不使用阴影分隔。 |
| `--surface-panel` | #ffffff | #20242b | 右栏、浮层与对话框。 |
| `--surface-input` | #ffffff | #252a32 | 输入框与 Composer 内部。 |
| `--surface-code` | #f0f2f6 | #161b22 | 代码、命令与 Diff 上下文；有界横向滚动。 |
| `--surface-user` | #e9edf3 | #282e38 | 用户消息轻背景，避免气泡套卡片。 |
| `--backdrop` | #10182666 | #05080db3 | 模态遮罩；仅 overlay 使用。 |

**Interaction states** (same roles, suffixed):

| token | light | dark |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface-hover` | #e5e9ef | #303741 |
| `--surface-pressed` | #d8dfe9 | #3b4553 |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--text-primary, #202631);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */

/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #202631;
```

### Tokens (4)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--text-primary` | #202631 | #e9edf4 | 主文本，位于所有 surface-* 实色底。 |
| `--text-secondary` | #4f5b6b | #b0bbc9 | 辅助信息，位于所有基础背景；不得通过 opacity 再淡化。 |
| `--text-muted` | #536171 | #a7b4c4 | 时间、元数据与未激活标签，保持 4.5:1。 |
| `--text-on-primary` | #ffffff | #1b2432 | 中性 primary 按钮唯一前景。 |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 400 12px/18px "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", "Microsoft YaHei UI", sans-serif;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-caption);
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `caption` | `.caption`, `--text-caption` | 12px / 18px | 400 | `sans` | 时间、状态与辅助字段；不小于12px。 |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 12px / 18px | 600 | `sans` | 分组名、表单标签。 |
| `ui-body` | `.ui-body`, `--text-ui-body` | 13px / 20px | 400 | `sans` | 侧栏、菜单、设置字段。 |
| `ui-strong` | `.ui-strong`, `--text-ui-strong` | 13px / 20px | 600 | `sans` | 选中行、主要按钮。 |
| `prose` | `.prose`, `--text-prose` | 14px / 24px | 400 | `sans` | 中文与英文聊天正文。 |
| `section` | `.section`, `--text-section` | 16px / 24px | 600 | `sans` | 消息小标题、面板章节。 |
| `title` | `.title`, `--text-title` | 20px / 28px | 600 | `sans` | 页面与对话框标题。 |
| `display` | `.display`, `--text-display` | 28px / 36px | 600 | `sans` | 空会话引导，禁止营销 hero 大标题。 |
| `code` | `.code`, `--text-code` | 12px / 20px | 400 | `mono` | 代码块、路径、命令。 |
| `code-small` | `.code-small`, `--text-code-small` | 12px / 18px | 400 | `mono` | Diff 行号、工具元数据。 |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `"Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", "Microsoft YaHei UI", sans-serif` |
| `mono` | `--font-mono` | `"Cascadia Code", Consolas, monospace` |
